HediffDef.label: Wraith living forge growth
HediffDef.description: Wraith living machinery is using this body as a scaffold while a living forge develops. The process continues if the host dies and remains in the corpse until maturation.

HediffDef.label: Wraith grav engine growth
HediffDef.description: Wraith propulsion tissue is using this body as a scaffold while a grav engine heart develops. The process continues if the host dies and remains in the corpse until maturation.
